policy.unit: unique chunk_id; overlapping chunks remain distinct
policy.positive_rule: A chunk independently and explicitly supports at least one complete predeclared required evidence unit. Multi-unit questions use the union of supporting chunks.
policy.context_rule: Do not borrow missing subjects, table headers, symbol definitions or units from other chunks. Topic overlap, isolated matching numbers and citations to a method are insufficient.
policy.evidence_units: Some units jointly require related facts, e.g. base_schedule requires both steps and hours in one chunk. Composite questions explicitly list multiple units.
policy.gpu_model_rule: For GPU quantity and model questions, P100 is accepted as the model identifier without requiring the manufacturer name in every chunk; eight and 8 are equivalent.
policy.table_rule: Accept readable captions, headers and rows present together. The training-steps interpretation of p9:c1 was cross-checked against local PDF page 9 layout extraction; its symbols alone are not standalone evidence for other facts.
policy.negative_coverage: All 51 chunks were considered per question; zero labels are listed explicitly as the complement of positives under this policy, not inferred from a retrieval top-K pool.
policy.no_answer_policy: Five unanswerable questions have empty relevant sets, are excluded from Recall/MRR averages and must be reported separately. An answerable question with no retrieved hit contributes zero.
policy.metric_limit: Chunk Recall and first-hit MRR do not establish complete fact coverage, answer correctness or citation entailment. Overlap can give multiple relevant chunks for the same fact.
policy.evaluation_status: Development/learning annotations; the assistant has seen previous learning outputs. Not a blind held-out benchmark or independently human-adjudicated gold standard.
